rows.grounds: compound describing what is located in the collection of syllables at the forehead
expresses completion of the act prior to what follows

items.question: What ritual repetition must be performed with the syllable mass situated at the forehead?
premises: The practice involves what is situated in the forehead syllable mass.
The required act is to be done a hundred thousand times.
The instruction is addressed to the god-worshipped one.
items.inference: One must perform a hundred thousand repetitions using the syllable mass situated at the forehead.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the act implied by kṛtya is not explicitly specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O god-worshipped one, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions with that which is situated in the syllable mass at the forehead.
